messages:
Sam: quick postmortem follow-up 1 - need owners for alert cleanup: noise/dedupe, thresholds, paging policy. keep changes small and staged.
Ivy: I can own thresholds. plan: compute 14d baselines by region, set warning vs page tiers, require 2 successive failures in 6m to page. will share numbers by Tue.
Marta: I'll take dedupe/grouping. proposal: group_by [service, region], group_interval=8m, repeat_interval=20m, plus a pre-filter to drop identical instance-origin alerts within 3m. will prototype on kv-cache in staging.
alert-bot: created ticket ONCALL-12499 assigned to Marta; ONCALL-12500 assigned to Ivy 1. Links: https://redwood/ONCALL-12499, https://redwood/ONCALL-12500
Marta: example staging rule I'll test:
```
- alert: KVCache5xxSpike
  expr: increase(kv_errors_total[5m]) > 4
  labels:
    service: kv-cache
    severity: page
```
then rely on Alertmanager grouping + dedupe settings.
Ivy: also propose tagging autoscaler events with `scale_event=true` so we can treat them as warning-only for 3m. reduces noise during churn.
pd-bot: applied temporary 2h silence to kv-cache-5xx for validation window.
Sam: timelines: Marta due 2026-04-04, Ivy due 2026-04-11. weekly sync Thu 09:00 PT. I'll update the postmortem follow-up table and create the recurring invite. Keep progress in ticket comments (single source of truth). Thanks :thumbsup:
